snippet.title: Zero Caliber 2 - Official Steam Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get another look at Zero Caliber 2 in this action-packed trailer for the VR shooter sequel to the military shooter. Zero Caliber 2 features include tons of weapons to unlock, a single-player/co-op campaign, and PvP. Zero Caliber 2 will be available on Steam in Q3 2025. It is available now on Meta Quest.
